fusions.name: Quarry Marked
fusions.desc: Reaches an arm across the gap, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, rising to 1.5 times that at the full 6 tiles. The target is [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks an arm tip that deals 5 damage and has a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Taste of the Kill
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
